title: crustaceous
summary: Hard-shelled or crust-like; the adjective for crabs, lobsters, shrimp, and other crustaceans.
whyItMatters: In botany it can also describe a hard, brittle seed coat, including on some legumes. For eating texture, English usually wants crunchy, crisp, or snap, not this word.
notes: A crossword clue like “crunchy legumes” is looking for snap beans, not crustaceous.
